kind: check-point decision on the coarse masked preview (registration_protocol.md section 2 step 4); written before any full-resolution view of the layer
what_the_preview_shows: A patchwork of several photographs with different contrast. Roads, Wadi en-Nuʿeima, the town of Jericho and the relief of Jebel Quruntul are clear. South of the mask a bright area matches the tell's south half. The spring house and reservoir are not identifiable at 8 m per pixel. At Kh. el-Mafjar a bright patch lies at or within about 30 m of the reference palace centre.
decision: The spring is not identifiable on the preview, so the check point is RP-TELL-FOOT-W (the first identifiable candidate in the declared order: the west edge of the bright mound is visible just south of the mask).
controls: RP-TELL-FOOT-S, RP-TAWAHIN, RP-MEFJAR; RP-TELL-FOOT-E only if the spring proves identifiable at full resolution (its line runs through the spring). The spring itself is then not used.
layer_offset_coarse: Not distinguishable from zero at 8 m per pixel (|offset| about 30 m or less at Kh. el-Mafjar). Taken as (0, 0) for the mask.

full_resolution_mask_grid.basis: mask_grid E 191800-192550, N 142120-142700, offset (0,0), widened 75 m west, east and north and 50 m south

gate_reminder: The resolvability gate (declaration) is measured on full-resolution views outside this mask before any decision to open the zone.
